correctness.rationale: In the loop-retaining parent-edge binary signature, FO1 sees only whether nonroot points exist. At width two, first-level leafless type M0, positive-child type M+, and leaf type L have 2-variable definitions. Permanent two-pebble anchored atomic profiles are exactly controlled by cap2(t0), cap2(t+), cap2(L), with 3+6+3=12 feasible triples. For k>=3, the parent relation is a total unary map with f^2(x)=root; relevant term atoms translate capture-safely with three names. A k-variable formula detects k children by fixing k-1 siblings and rebinding their parent variable, then compares parent of the next child. Truncated branch child-degree types and multiplicities up to k admit a permanent matching game and every (k+1)-tuple of 0..k occurs, giving (k+1)^(k+1) classes. Independently checked 19 rooted structures with <=6 points using set-based k-pebble refinement, zero pairwise mismatches for k=1,2,3 (2,11,16 classes observed in bounded sample), not an exhaustive infinite proof.
